title: Calculate the size of an object. — obj_size
text: obj_size() attempts take account size environments associated object. particularly important closures formulas, since otherwise may realise accidentally captured large object. However, easy count: want include size every object every environment leading back emptyenv(). obj_size() takes heuristic approach: never counts size global environment, base environment, empty environment, namespace.
